program.name: Inn staffing
program.source: function step(ctx) { const inns=ctx.game.buildings({team:ctx.myTeam,limit:100}).filter(b=>b.shortType===1 && !b.virtual); const orders=[]; for(const b of inns) if(b.workers!==4 && orders.length<32) orders.push({type:'workers',building:{id:b.id,generation:b.generation},workers:4}); return {output:{inns:inns.length,staffing:inns.map(b=>({id:b.id,workers:b.workers})),ordersQueued:orders.length},orders}; }

program.name: Workforce threshold watch
program.source: let wasAbove=false; let pending=false; function step(ctx) { const units=ctx.game.units({team:ctx.myTeam,limit:200}); const workers=units.filter(u=>u.type===0).length; const above=workers>15; const inns=ctx.game.buildings({team:ctx.myTeam,limit:100}).filter(b=>b.shortType===1 && !b.virtual); const orders=[]; if(pending && inns.some(b=>b.priority===1)) { ctx.wakeAgent({key:'workforce-over-15',reason:'Workforce exceeded 15; inn priority is now high.',data:{tick:ctx.tick,workers}}); pending=false; } if(above && !wasAbove) { const inn=inns[0]; if(inn) { if(inn.priority===1) { ctx.wakeAgent({key:'workforce-over-15',reason:'Workforce exceeded 15; inn was already high priority.',data:{tick:ctx.tick,workers}}); } else { orders.push({type:'priority',building:{id:inn.id,generation:inn.generation},priority:1}); pending=true; } } } wasAbove=above; return {output:{tick:ctx.tick,workers,above15:above,innPriority:inns.length?inns[0].priority:null},orders}; }
program.description: When the workforce crosses above 15 workers, raise the inn to high priority and report after the priority change is observed.

reports: Standing order installed to monitor the workforce every 25 ticks. You currently have 12 workers, and your inn is at normal priority. If the workforce grows past 15, the order will raise the inn’s priority and report back once the change is observed.
